description: Canonical absence-language anchor list for code-reviewer-verifier trigger detection. Exact-substring anchors are matched anywhere in a finding description. Prefix anchors (in anchors_prefix_patterns) are matched at the start of a finding description. When any anchor matches, the finding must include a verification_evidence field with command and output sub-fields. Loaded at runtime by validate-review-output.sh; fail-closed if this file is absent or malformed.
